name: orchestrate
description: A task router for Claude Code: detect the task type (research · design · implement · debug · review · optimize) and run a pre-curated, model-tiered workflow — a shared sequential prelude that unblocks a parallel fan-out to cheaper tiers (Sonnet builds, Haiku scouts), then a convergence. Opus orchestrates by default; swap to Fable in natural language. Ships the /orchestrate router, an /orchestrate-workflows companion (run/manage/explain), pre-tiered subagents, a SessionStart doctrine, and layered repo+user JSON config.
